description: On the green cloth in front of you are piles of colorful pony beads, a black tape dispenser, a red string, and a short strand of green beads already on a black cord. The left hand steadies the cord near the small green-bead strand while the right hand reaches to the blue bead pile, pinches a single bead, brings it back toward the cord, and uses both hands together to guide the bead onto and down the cord, then the right hand lifts away to pick another bead.
